/* service='personhog-identity', operation='delete_mark_victims' */ 
        INSERT INTO lifecycle_op_person_tmp (op_id, team_id, person_id, person_uuid, role, status, mark_active)
        SELECT $1, $2, u.person_id, u.person_uuid, 'victim', $5, true
        FROM unnest($3::bigint[], $4::uuid[]) AS u(person_id, person_uuid)
        ON CONFLICT (team_id, person_id) WHERE mark_active DO NOTHING
        RETURNING person_id
